scope: New continuation source only; no GPU, model or old 41-test panel run

findings.initial_issue: Hash-binding five caller-authored JSON files still admits self-declared verified/prelaunch_counted_limits/frozen facts; the caller also supplies the supposed externally frozen hash.
findings.consequence: These receipts are not independent native clearance.
findings.owner_response: Current native gate hard-block added before receipt validation. Future trusted release authority remains an explicit integration requirement.

findings.initial_issue: Child exit was handled before elapsed/global deadline check.
findings.consequence: A just-finished overdue worker could be labeled COMPLETE.
findings.owner_response: Deadline checked before accepting exit status.

findings.initial_issue: COMPLETE allowed unknown actual resource values.
findings.consequence: Incomplete accounting could be represented as completion.
findings.owner_response: Unknown COMPLETE changed to durable COUNTER_INVALID and family stopped.

findings.initial_issue: Observed counters above reservation were rejected before preserving the larger counts.
findings.consequence: Ledger could charge only reservation despite observed overrun.
findings.owner_response: Observed counts saved before refusal and charged through OVERRUN.

findings.initial_issue: A process_creation failure after child creation but before Job assignment closed handles without terminating the own suspended child.
findings.consequence: An owned suspended child could leak outside Job containment.
findings.owner_response: Assigned state tracked and only the newly created own child terminated on pre-assignment exception.

findings.initial_issue: Fresh contexts destroyed before transaction.complete and final JSON allocations; a later exception could make transaction destructor dereference freed owner pointers.
findings.owner_response: Sent to frontend owner; awaiting final source.

findings.initial_issue: Capture output files could be written before failure, while capture_bytes retained its initial zero.
findings.consequence: Failure accounting could report false zero capture bytes.
findings.owner_response: Additive operator-v3 measures every attempted binary output path after catch and emits null/lower-bound when file attributes are unavailable.

required_scope_limits: Restricted process inventory is not host-wide duplicate-work clearance
Local app title/time/catalog matches are not original execution-thread terminal evidence
CPU Job/mutex/deadline tests do not prove a GPU native execution is admitted
Capture callbacks and source patches do not attest always-on clean dispatch
Standalone explicit launch counters do not bound a full model backend
Native graph/quantizer/kernel counters and independent full-output/state reference bridge remain necessary before GPU timing
Old e01 sources, old ledgers and old results remain read-only
